headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 9 studies yielded an effect size of 1.03 (95% CI: 0.96–1.11), indicating no statistically significant association between folic acid and prostate cancer\aggressive. Although the point estimate suggests a potential positive relationship, the confidence interval includes the null. These findings were accompanied by moderate heterogeneity (I² = 47.95%), suggesting some variability in the results across studies.
